text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaaaah! Bakushin! Bakushin!
BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Grk?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: B-BAKU, BA...KU... Bakuuu!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr, h-how are you...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I guess I have to say it then, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You really were the wind!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOO! Zephyr! Zephyr! Zephyrrr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for your support.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(I've gained the strength to dominate
mile races,
and the speed to dominate
sprint races.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (To become the true wind...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (There's just one more thing I need!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr returns to the runners'
tunnel
after a stunning victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her expression is clear and cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And her spirit is filled with a fierce,
unshakable
determination as she gears
up for the final stage.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer... It's finally time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's get going. The final stage awaits.
The wind
stream that will take us
beyond even the Mile
Emperor...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...The autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I return to my room and
reflect on
everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved victories in the Yasuda
Kinen
and Sprinters Stakes, Yamanin
Zephyr is now
headed for the autumn
Tenno Sho...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She will attempt to break the distance
barrier, a
feat that not even the Mile
Emperor was capable
of. So it's got me
thinking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I clench my fists as I rack my brain.
choice_data_list: 俺に、もっとできることはないのか……！
私に、もっとできることはないのかな……！
choice_data_list_en: Isn't there more I can do...?!
Isn't there anything more I can do...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a memory from back before
summer
pops into my head.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I've learned that if I involve my fans and
rivals in
my efforts, I will become the
wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to go the extra mile
this
summer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wish to bathe in the blast winds, in the
floral
winds—to breathe them all in and
turn them into
strength.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So please—let me do this, so I can grow
stronger
and become a true tempest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr said that the influence
of the
formidable opponents she runs
alongside could
help her grow stronger
and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer. I'm ready for another day
of—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Zephyr. I'm looking forward to
running with
you today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, heeey. Don't go too hard on me, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm allll fired up! Let's hurry up and do
this!
C'mon, let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... I-I'm also ready to start whenever!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Wait...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're all scheduled to enter the autumn
Tenno
Sho, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, it sounded like I could stand to
benefit a
bunch too, so yeah. Was happy
to accept the
offer.
choice_data_list: 合同トレーニングをお願いしたんだ
choice_data_list_en: I asked if we could do joint training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, I didn't expect a lineup like this! I got the willies when I arrived at the track.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Buuut thinking back... you looked pretty
zonked
when you came to talk to us,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing you'd been running around
all over
the place, right? Ahh, the spirit
of youth!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh... Hehe, hehehe.
choice_data_list: そ、それは黙っておいてもらえると……
choice_data_list_en: I-I'd appreciate it if you kept quiet about that...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Aw, what a shame. I would've liked to
have seen
you rushing around like a gust
of wind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I extend my respect and
appreciation to
the comforting breeze
that blows on as always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yamanin Zephyr and the others
begin
their final preparations for the
autumn Tenno
Sho!
